answers.core: This should be a core feature that improves the Engine as a whole and can lead to significantly easier making local co-op without having to waste time on making a whole system or duplicating input maps per player.
answers.workaround: Current solution requires either checking what input type is being pressed and adding a tag of it's ID by the device type. So that each input device has a unique ID. Or by making multiple input maps for each player which is troublesome and just annoying.
